effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [dramon] or [Justimon] in its name among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn] When you attack with a black Digimon, you may suspend this Tamer to have that Digimon get +1000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
